<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8"/>
	<xsl:key name="Chaves" match="ROOT/ide/Comentarios" use="chave"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<NeoGridFiscalList>
			<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/CTE[Emit/CNPJ != '']">
				<NeoGridFiscalDoc>
					<Messages>
						<Message docType="CTe" flowType="send">
							<CTe xmlns="http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/cte">
								<infCte>
									<xsl:attribute name="Id">CTe<xsl:value-of select="chCTe"/>

									<xsl:attribute name="versao">
										<xsl:value-of select="versao"/>

									<ide>
										<cUF>

										</CFOP>
										<natOp>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/natOp"/>

											</forPag>
										</xsl:if>
										<mod>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/mod"/>
										</mod>
										<xsl:choose>
											<xsl:when test="ide/serie = ''">
												<serie/>
											</xsl:when>
											<xsl:otherwise>
												<serie>
													<xsl:value-of select="format-number(ide/serie, "##")"/>
												</serie>
											</xsl:otherwise>
										</xsl:choose>
										<xsl:choose>
											<xsl:when test="ide/nCT = ''">
												<nCT/>
											</xsl:when>
											<xsl:otherwise>
												<nCT>
													<xsl:value-of select="format-number(ide/nCT, "########")"/>
												</nCT>
											</xsl:otherwise>
										</xsl:choose>
										<dhEmi>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/dhEmi"/>
										</dhEmi>
										<tpImp>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpImp"/>
										</tpImp>
										<tpEmis>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpEmis"/>
										</tpEmis>
										<cDV>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cDV"/>
										</cDV>
										<tpAmb>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpAmb"/>
										</tpAmb>
										<tpCTe>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpCTe"/>
										</tpCTe>
										<procEmi>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/procEmi"/>
										</procEmi>
										<verProc>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/verproc!=''">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/verproc"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>2.00</xsl:otherwise>
											</xsl:choose>
										</verProc>
										<xsl:if test="ide/refCTe != ''">
											<refCTE>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/refCTe"/>
											</refCTE>
										</xsl:if>
										<cMunEnv>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cMunEnv"/>
										</cMunEnv>
										<xMunEnv>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/xMunEnv"/>
										</xMunEnv>
										<UFEnv>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/UFEnv"/>
										</UFEnv>
										<modal>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/modal"/>
										</modal>
										<tpServ>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpServ"/>
										</tpServ>
										<cMunIni>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cMunIni"/>
										</cMunIni>
										<xMunIni>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/xMunIni"/>
										</xMunIni>
										<UFIni>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/UFIni"/>
										</UFIni>
										<cMunFim>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cMunFim"/>
										</cMunFim>
										<xMunFim>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/xMunFim"/>
										</xMunFim>
										<UFFim>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/UFFim"/>
										</UFFim>
										<retira>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/retira"/>
										</retira>
										<xsl:if test="ide/xdetretira != ''">
											<xDetRetira>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/xdetretira"/>
											</xDetRetira>
										</xsl:if>
										<xsl:if test="boolean(ide/toma3) or boolean(ide/toma4)">
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/toma3/toma !=''">
													<toma03>
														<toma>
															<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma3/toma"/>
														</toma>
													</toma03>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>
													<toma4>
														<toma>
															<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/toma"/>
														</toma>
														<xsl:choose>
															<xsl:when test="normalize-space(ide/toma4/cpfToma/valor)='' or  number(ide/toma4/cpfToma/valor)='0'">
																<CNPJ>
																	<xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(ide/toma4/cnpjToma/valor)"/>
																</CNPJ>
															</xsl:when>
															<xsl:otherwise>
																<CPF>
																	<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/cpfToma/valor"/>
																</CPF>
															</xsl:otherwise>
														</xsl:choose>
														<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/IE != ''">
															<IE>
																<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ide/toma4/IE,'/',''),'-',''),'.','')"/>
															</IE>
														</xsl:if>
														<xNome>
															<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/xNome"/>
														</xNome>
														<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/xFant != ''">
															<xFant>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/xFant"/>
															</xFant>
														</xsl:if>
														<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/xFone != ''">
															<fone>
																<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(ide/toma4/xFone,'(',''),')',''),'.',''),',',''),'/',''),' ',''),'-','')"/>
															</fone>
														</xsl:if>
														<enderToma>
															<xLgr>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/xLgr"/>
															</xLgr>
															<nro>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/nro"/>
															</nro>
															<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/enderToma/xCpl != ''">
																<xCpl>
																	<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/xCpl"/>
																</xCpl>
															</xsl:if>
															<xBairro>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/xBairro"/>
															</xBairro>
															<cMun>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/cMun"/>
															</cMun>
															<xMun>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/xMun"/>
															</xMun>
															<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/enderToma/Cep != ''">
																<CEP>
																	<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/Cep"/>
																</CEP>
															</xsl:if>
															<UF>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/UF"/>
															</UF>
															<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/enderToma/cPais != ''">
																<cPais>
																	<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/cPais"/>
																</cPais>
															</xsl:if>
															<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/enderToma/xPais != ''">
																<xPais>
																	<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/xPais"/>
																</xPais>
															</xsl:if>
														</enderToma>
														<!-- VERIFICAR -->
														<xsl:if test="ide/toma4/enderToma/email!='' and number(ide/toma4/enderToma/email)!='0'">
															<email>
																<xsl:value-of select="ide/toma4/enderToma/email"/>

																</dIni>

															</semData>

																</tpHor>

																	<xsl:value-of select="Entrega2/hProg"/>
																</hProg>
															</comHora>
														</xsl:when>
														<xsl:when test="Entrega2/hlni!='' or Entrega2/hFim!=''">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsl:stylesheet exclude-result-prefixes="ng" version="1.0" extension-element-prefixes="ng" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:ng="com.neogrid.integrator.XSLFunctions">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<MDFe xmlns="http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/mdfe">
			<infMDFe>
				<xsl:attribute name="versao">
					<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/versao"/>
				</xsl:attribute>
				<xsl:attribute name="Id">
					<xsl:choose>
						<xsl:when test="/ROOT/ide/Id!=''">
							<xsl:value-of select="concat('MDFe', /ROOT/ide/Id)"/>
						</xsl:when>
					</xsl:choose>
				</xsl:attribute>
				<ide>
					<cUF>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/cUF"/>
					</cUF>
					<tpAmb>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/tpAmb"/>
					</tpAmb>
					<tpEmit>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/tpEmit"/>
					</tpEmit>
					<xsl:if test="/ROOT/ide/tpTransp !=''">
						<tpTransp>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/tpTransp"/>
						</tpTransp>
					</xsl:if>	
					<mod>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/mod"/>
					</mod>
					<serie>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/serie"/>
					</serie>
					<nMDF>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/nMDF"/>
					</nMDF>
					<cMDF>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/cMDF"/>
					</cMDF>
					<cDV>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/cDV"/>
					</cDV>
					<modal>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/modal"/>
					</modal>
					<dhEmi>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/dhEmi"/>
					</dhEmi>
					<tpEmis>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/tpEmis"/>
					</tpEmis>
					<procEmi>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/procEmi"/>
					</procEmi>
					<verProc>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/verProc"/>
					</verProc>
					<UFIni>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/UFIni"/>
					</UFIni>
					<UFFim>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/UFFim"/>
					</UFFim>
					<xsl:for-each select="/ROOT/ide/infcMunCarrega">
						<infMunCarrega>
							<cMunCarrega>
								<xsl:value-of select="cMunCarrega"/>
							</cMunCarrega>
							<xMunCarrega>
								<xsl:value-of select="xMunCarrega"/>
							</xMunCarrega>
						</infMunCarrega>
					</xsl:for-each>
					<xsl:for-each select="/ROOT/ide/infPercurso[UFPer != '']">
						<infPercurso>
							<UFPer>
								<xsl:value-of select="UFPer"/>
							</UFPer>
						</infPercurso>
					</xsl:for-each>
					<xsl:if test="/ROOT/ide/dhIniViagem !=''">
						<dhIniViagem>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/dhIniViagem"/>
						</dhIniViagem>
					</xsl:if>
					<xsl:if test="/ROOT/ide/indCanalVerde !=''">
						<indCanalVerde>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/indCanalVerde"/>
						</indCanalVerde>
					</xsl:if>
					<xsl:if test="/ROOT/ide/indCarregaPosterior !=''">
						<indCarregaPosterior>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/ide/indCarregaPosterior"/>
						</indCarregaPosterior>
					</xsl:if>
				</ide>
				<emit>
					<CNPJ>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/CNPJ"/>
					</CNPJ>
					<IE>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/IE"/>
					</IE>
					<xNome>
						<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/xNome"/>
					</xNome>
					<xsl:if test="/ROOT/emit/xFant != ''">
						<xFant>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/xFant"/>
						</xFant>
					</xsl:if>
					<enderEmit>
						<xLgr>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/xLgr"/>
						</xLgr>
						<nro>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/nro"/>
						</nro>
						<xsl:if test="/ROOT/emit/xCpl != ''">
							<xCpl>
								<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/xCpl"/>
							</xCpl>
						</xsl:if>
						<xBairro>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/xBairro"/>
						</xBairro>
						<cMun>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/cMun"/>
						</cMun>
						<xMun>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/xMun"/>
						</xMun>
						<xsl:if test="/ROOT/emit/CEP != ''">
							<CEP>
								<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/CEP"/>
							</CEP>
						</xsl:if>
						<UF>
							<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/UF"/>
						</UF>
						<xsl:if test="/ROOT/emit/fone != ''">
							<fone>
								<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/fone"/>
							</fone>
						</xsl:if>
						<xsl:if test="/ROOT/emit/email != ''">
							<email>
								<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/emit/email"/>
							</email>
						</xsl:if>
					</enderEmit>
				</emit>
				<infModal versaoModal="3.00">
					<xsl:choose>
						<xsl:when test="boolean (/ROOT/rodo)">
							<rodo>
								<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/RNTRC[1] != '' or /ROOT/rodo/CIOT != ''">
									<infANTT>
										<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/RNTRC[1] != ''">
											<RNTRC>
												<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/rodo/RNTRC[1]"/>
											</RNTRC>
										</xsl:if>
										<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/CIOT != ''">
											<infCIOT>	
												<CIOT>
													<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/rodo/CIOT"/>
												</CIOT>
												<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/CPF_CIOT != ''">
													<CPF>
														<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/rodo/CPF_CIOT"/>
													</CPF>
												</xsl:if>
												<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/CNPJ_CIOT != ''">
													<CNPJ>
														<xsl:value-of select="/ROOT/rodo/CNPJ_CIOT"/>
													</CNPJ>
												</xsl:if>
											</infCIOT>											
										</xsl:if>
										<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/valePed/CNPJForn != ''">
											<valePed>
												<xsl:for-each select="/ROOT/rodo/valePed[CNPJForn != '']">
													<disp>
														<CNPJForn>
															<xsl:value-of select="CNPJForn"/>
														</CNPJForn>
														<xsl:if test="CNPJPg != ''">
															<CNPJPg>
																<xsl:value-of select="CNPJPg"/>
															</CNPJPg>
														</xsl:if>
														<xsl:if test="CPFPg != ''">
															<CPFPg>
																<xsl:value-of select="CPFPg"/>
															</CPFPg>
														</xsl:if>
														<nCompra>
															<xsl:value-of select="nCompra"/>
														</nCompra>
														<vValePed>
															<xsl:value-of select="vValePed"/>
														</vValePed>
													</disp>
												</xsl:for-each>
											</valePed>
										</xsl:if>
										<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/infContratante/xNome != '' or /ROOT/rodo/infContratante/CPF != '' or /ROOT/rodo/infContratante/CNPJ != '' or /ROOT/rodo/infContratante/idEstrangeiro != ''">
											<xsl:for-each select="/ROOT/rodo/infContratante">
												<infContratante>
													<xsl:if test="xNome != ''">
														<xNome>
															<xsl:value-of select="xNome"/>
														</xNome>
													</xsl:if>
													<xsl:if test="CPF != ''">
														<CPF>
															<xsl:value-of select="CPF"/>
														</CPF>
													</xsl:if>
													<xsl:if test="CNPJ != ''">
														<CNPJ>
															<xsl:value-of select="CNPJ"/>
														</CNPJ>
													</xsl:if>
													<xsl:if test="idEstrangeiro != ''">
														<idEstrangeiro>
															<xsl:value-of select="idEstrangeiro"/>
														</idEstrangeiro>
													</xsl:if>
												</infContratante>
											</xsl:for-each>
										</xsl:if>
										<xsl:if test="/ROOT/rodo/infPag/xNome != '' or /ROOT/rodo/infPag/CPF != '' or /ROOT/rodo/infPag/CNPJ != '' or /ROOT/rodo/infPag/idEstrangeiro != ''">
											<xsl:for-each select="/ROOT/rodo/infPag">
												<infPag>
													<xsl:if test="xNome != ''">
														<xNome>
															<xsl:value-of select="xNome"/>
														</xNome>
													</xsl:if>
													<xsl:if test="CPF != ''">
														<CPF>
															<xsl:value-of select="CPF"/>
														</CPF>

<xsl:stylesheet exclude-result-prefixes="ng" version="1.0" extension-element-prefixes="ng" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:ng="com.neogrid.integrator.XSLFunctions">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<!--Mapa xsl para versao 2.06 do layout txt padrao NeoGrid-->
			<NFe xmlns="http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe">
				<infNFe>
					<xsl:attribute name="versao">2.00</xsl:attribute>
					<xsl:attribute name="Id">NFe<xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(ROOT/chave/chNFe)"/></xsl:attribute>
					<ide>
						<cUF>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/cUF"/>
						</cUF>
						<cNF>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/cNF"/>
						</cNF>
						<natOp>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/natOp"/>
						</natOp>
						<indPag>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/indPag"/>
						</indPag>
						<mod>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/mod"/>
						</mod>
						<serie>
							<xsl:value-of select="number(ROOT/Cabecalho/serie)"/>
						</serie>
						<nNF>
							<xsl:value-of select="number(ROOT/Cabecalho/nNF)"/>
						</nNF>
						<dEmi>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/dEmi"/>
						</dEmi>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/dSaiEnt!=''">
							<dSaiEnt>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/dSaiEnt"/>
							</dSaiEnt>
						</xsl:if>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/hSaiEnt!=''">
							<hSaiEnt>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/hSaiEnt"/>
							</hSaiEnt>
						</xsl:if>
						<tpNF>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpNF"/>
						</tpNF>
						<cMunFG>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/cMunFG"/>
						</cMunFG>
					<!--Inicio Notas Referenciadas-->
						<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/Cabecalho[refNFe!='' and number(refNFe)!='0']">
							<NFref>
								<refNFe>
									<xsl:value-of select="refNFe"/>
								</refNFe>
							</NFref>
						</xsl:for-each>
						<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/Cabecalho[cUF_refNF!='' and number(cUF_refNF)!='0' and AAMM_refNF!='' and number(AAMM_refNF)!='0']">
							<NFref>
								<refNF>
									<cUF>
										<xsl:value-of select="cUF_refNF"/>
									</cUF>
									<AAMM>
										<xsl:value-of select="AAMM_refNF"/>
									</AAMM>
									<CNPJ>
										<xsl:value-of select="CNPJ_refNF"/>
									</CNPJ>
									<mod>
										<xsl:value-of select="mod_refNF"/>
									</mod>
									<serie>
										<xsl:value-of select="number(serie_refNF)"/>
									</serie>
									<nNF>
										<xsl:value-of select="number(nNF_refNF)"/>
									</nNF>
								</refNF>
							</NFref>
						</xsl:for-each>
						<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/Cabecalho[cUF_refNFP!='' and number(cUF_refNFP)!='0' and AAMM_refNFP!='' and number(AAMM_refNFP)!='0']">	
							<NFref>
								<refNFP>
									<cUF>
										<xsl:value-of select="cUF_refNFP"/>
									</cUF>
									<AAMM>
										<xsl:value-of select="AAMM_refNFP"/>
									</AAMM>
									<xsl:choose>
										<xsl:when test="CNPJ_refNFP!='' and number(CNPJ_refNFP)!='0'">
											<CNPJ>
												<xsl:value-of select="CNPJ_refNFP"/>
											</CNPJ>
										</xsl:when>
										<xsl:otherwise>
											<CPF>
												<xsl:value-of select="CPF_refNFP"/>
											</CPF>
										</xsl:otherwise>
									</xsl:choose>
									<IE>
										<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(IE_refNFP,'/',''),'-',''),'.','')"/>
									</IE>
									<mod>
										<xsl:value-of select="mod_refNFP"/>
									</mod>
									<serie>
										<xsl:value-of select="number(serie_refNFP)"/>
									</serie>
									<nNF>
										<xsl:value-of select="number(nNF_refNFP)"/>
									</nNF>
								</refNFP>
							</NFref>
						</xsl:for-each>
						<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/Cabecalho[refCTe!='' and number(refCTe)!='0']">
							<NFref>
								<refCTe>
									<xsl:value-of select="refCTe"/>
								</refCTe>
							</NFref>
						</xsl:for-each>
						<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/Cabecalho[nECF_refECF!='' and number(nECF_refECF)!='0' and nCOO_refECF!='' and number(nCOO_refECF)!='0']">
							<NFref>
								<refECF>
									<mod>
										<xsl:value-of select="mod_refECF"/>
									</mod>
									<nECF>
										<xsl:value-of select="nECF_refECF"/>
									</nECF>
									<nCOO>
										<xsl:value-of select="nCOO_refECF"/>
									</nCOO>
								</refECF>
							</NFref>
						</xsl:for-each>
					<!--Fim Notas Referenciadas-->
						<tpImp>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpImp!=''">
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpImp"/>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>1</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
						</tpImp>
						<tpEmis>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpEmis!=''">
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpEmis"/>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>1</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
						</tpEmis>
						<cDV>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/cDV"/>
						</cDV>
						<tpAmb>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpAmb!=''">
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpAmb"/>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>2</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
						</tpAmb>
						<finNFe>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/finNFe"/>
						</finNFe>
						<procEmi>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/procEmi!=''">
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/procEmi"/>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>0</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
						</procEmi>
						<verProc>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/verProc!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/verProc)!='0'">
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/verProc"/>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>5.0</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
						</verProc>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/dhCont!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/xJust!=''">
							<dhCont>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/dhCont"/>
							</dhCont>
							<xJust>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/xJust"/>
							</xJust>
						</xsl:if>
					</ide>
					<emit>
						<xsl:choose>
							<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CPF!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CPF)!='0'">
								<CPF>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CPF,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
								</CPF>
							</xsl:when>
							<xsl:otherwise>
								<CNPJ>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CNPJ,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
								</CNPJ>
							</xsl:otherwise>
						</xsl:choose>
						<xNome>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/Nome"/>
						</xNome>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xFant!=''">
							<xFant>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xFant"/>
							</xFant>
						</xsl:if>
						<enderEmit>
							<xLgr>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xLgr"/>
							</xLgr>
							<nro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/nro"/>
							</nro>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xCpl!=''">
								<xCpl>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xCpl"/>
								</xCpl>
							</xsl:if>
							<xBairro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xBairro"/>
							</xBairro>
							<cMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/cMun"/>
							</cMun>
							<xMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xMun"/>
							</xMun>
							<UF>
								<xsl:variable name="minusculas">abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz</xsl:variable>
								<xsl:variable name="maiusculas">ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ</xsl:variable>
								<xsl:value-of select="translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/UF,$minusculas,$maiusculas)"/>
							</UF>
							<CEP>
								<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CEP,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
							</CEP>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/cPais!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/cPais)!='0'">
								<cPais>1058</cPais>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xPais!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/xPais)!='0'">
								<xPais>Brasil</xPais>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/fone!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/fone)!='0'">
								<fone>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/fone,'(',''),')',''),'.',''),',',''),'/',''),' ',''),'-','')"/>
								</fone>
							</xsl:if>
						</enderEmit>
						<IE>
							<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IE,'/',''),'-',''),'.','')"/>
						</IE>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IEST!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IEST)!='0'">
							<IEST>
								<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IEST,'/',''),'-',''),'.','')"/>
							</IEST>
						</xsl:if>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IM!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IM)!='0' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CNAE!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CNAE)!='0'">
							<IM>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/IM"/>
							</IM>
							<CNAE>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CNAE"/>
							</CNAE>
						</xsl:if>
						<CRT>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Emit/CRT"/>
						</CRT>
					</emit>
					<xsl:if test="boolean(ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa) and ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/CNPJ!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/xOrgao!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/matr!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/xAgente!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/UF!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/repEmi!=''">
						<avulsa>
							<CNPJ>
								<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/CNPJ,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
							</CNPJ>
							<xOrgao>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/xOrgao"/>
							</xOrgao>
							<matr>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/matr"/>
							</matr>
							<xAgente>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/xAgente"/>
							</xAgente>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/fone!=''">
								<fone>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/fone,'(',''),')',''),'.',''),',',''),'/',''),' ',''),'-','')"/>
								</fone>
							</xsl:if>
							<UF>
								<xsl:variable name="minusculas">abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz</xsl:variable>
								<xsl:variable name="maiusculas">ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ</xsl:variable>
								<xsl:value-of select="translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/UF,$minusculas,$maiusculas)"/>
							</UF>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/nDAR!=''">
								<nDAR>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/nDAR"/>
								</nDAR>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/dEmi!=''">
								<dEmi>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/dEmi"/>
								</dEmi>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/vDAR!=''">
								<vDAR>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/vDAR"/>
								</vDAR>
							</xsl:if>
							<repEmi>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/repEmi"/>
							</repEmi>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/dPag!=''">
								<dPag>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Avulsa/dPag"/>
								</dPag>
							</xsl:if>
						</avulsa>
					</xsl:if>
					<dest>
						<xsl:choose>
							<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CPF!='' and number (ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CPF)!='0'">
								<CPF>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CPF,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
								</CPF>
							</xsl:when>
							<xsl:otherwise>
								<CNPJ>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CNPJ,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
								</CNPJ>
							</xsl:otherwise>
						</xsl:choose>
						<xNome>
							<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xNome"/>
						</xNome>
						<enderDest>
							<xLgr>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xLgr"/>
							</xLgr>
							<nro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/nro"/>
							</nro>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xCpl!=''">
								<xCpl>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xCpl"/>
								</xCpl>
							</xsl:if>
							<xBairro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xBairro"/>
							</xBairro>
							<cMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/cMun"/>
							</cMun>
							<xMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xMun"/>
							</xMun>
							<UF>
								<xsl:variable name="minusculas">abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz</xsl:variable>
								<xsl:variable name="maiusculas">ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ</xsl:variable>
								<xsl:value-of select="translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/UF,$minusculas,$maiusculas)"/>
							</UF>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CEP!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CEP)!='0'">
								<CEP>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/CEP,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
								</CEP>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/cPais!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/cPais)!='0'">
								<cPais>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/cPais"/>
								</cPais>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xPais!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xPais)!='0'">
								<xPais>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/xPais"/>
								</xPais>
							</xsl:if>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/fone!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/fone)!='0'">
								<fone>
									<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/fone,'(',''),')',''),'.',''),',',''),'/',''),' ',''),'-','')"/>
								</fone>
							</xsl:if>
						</enderDest>
						<IE>
							<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/IE,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
						</IE>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/ISUF!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/ISUF)!='0'">
							<ISUF>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/ISUF"/>
							</ISUF>
						</xsl:if>
						<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/email!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/email)!='0'">
							<email>
								<xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(ROOT/Cabecalho/Dest/email)"/>
							</email>
						</xsl:if>
					</dest>
					<xsl:if test="boolean(ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada) and ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xLgr!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/nro!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xBairro!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/cMun!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xMun!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/UF!=''">
						<retirada>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/CPF!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/CPF)!='0'">
									<CPF>
										<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/CPF,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
									</CPF>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>
									<CNPJ>
										<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/CNPJ,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
									</CNPJ>
								</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
							<xLgr>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xLgr"/>
							</xLgr>
							<nro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/nro"/>
							</nro>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xCpl!=''">
								<xCpl>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xCpl"/>
								</xCpl>
							</xsl:if>
							<xBairro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xBairro"/>
							</xBairro>
							<cMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/cMun"/>
							</cMun>
							<xMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/xMun"/>
							</xMun>
							<UF>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Retirada/UF"/>
							</UF>
						</retirada>
					</xsl:if>
					<xsl:if test="boolean(ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega) and ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xLgr!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/nro!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xBairro!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/cMun!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xMun!='' and ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/UF!=''">
						<entrega>
							<xsl:choose>
								<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/CPF!='' and number(ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/CPF)!='0'">
									<CPF>
										<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/CPF,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
									</CPF>
								</xsl:when>
								<xsl:otherwise>
									<CNPJ>
										<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/CNPJ,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
									</CNPJ>
								</xsl:otherwise>
							</xsl:choose>
							<xLgr>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xLgr"/>
							</xLgr>
							<nro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/nro"/>
							</nro>
							<xsl:if test="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xCpl!=''">
								<xCpl>
									<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xCpl"/>
								</xCpl>
							</xsl:if>
							<xBairro>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xBairro"/>
							</xBairro>
							<cMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/cMun"/>
							</cMun>
							<xMun>
								<xsl:value-of select="ROOT/Cabecalho/Entrega/xMun"/>
							</xMun>
							<UF>

							<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpImp!=''">

							<xsl:otherwise>1</xsl:otherwise>

					</tpImp>

							<xsl:when test="ROOT/Cabecalho/tpEmis!=''">

<xsl:stylesheet exclude-result-prefixes="ng" version="1.0" extension-element-prefixes="ng" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:ng="com.neogrid.integrator.XSLFunctions">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<!--Mapa xsl para versao 2.06 do layout txt padrao NeoGrid-->
		<NeoGridFiscalList>
			<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/NFe[cnpjEmit/CNPJ != '' or cpfEmit/CPF !='']">
				<NeoGridFiscalDoc>
					<Messages>
						<Message docType="NFe" flowType="send">
							<NFe xmlns="http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe">
								<infNFe>
									<xsl:attribute name="versao">
										<xsl:value-of select="versao"/>
									</xsl:attribute>
									<xsl:attribute name="Id">
										<xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(Id)"/>
									</xsl:attribute>
									<ide>
										<cUF>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cUF"/>
										</cUF>
										<cNF>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cNF"/>
										</cNF>
										<natOp>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/natOp"/>
										</natOp>
										<mod>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/mod"/>
										</mod>
										<serie>
											<xsl:value-of select="number(ide/serie)"/>
										</serie>
										<nNF>
											<xsl:value-of select="number(ide/nNF)"/>
										</nNF>
										<dhEmi>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/dhEmi"/>
										</dhEmi>
										<xsl:if test="ide/dhSaiEnt!=''">
											<dhSaiEnt>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/dhSaiEnt"/>
											</dhSaiEnt>
										</xsl:if>
										<tpNF>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpNF"/>
										</tpNF>
										<idDest>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/idDest"/>
										</idDest>
										<cMunFG>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cMunFG"/>
										</cMunFG>
										<tpImp>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/tpImp!=''">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpImp"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>1</xsl:otherwise>

<xsl:stylesheet exclude-result-prefixes="ng" version="1.0" extension-element-prefixes="ng" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:ng="com.neogrid.integrator.XSLFunctions">
	<xsl:output method="xml" encoding="UTF-8"/>
	<xsl:template match="/">
		<!--Mapa xsl para versao 2.06 do layout txt padrao NeoGrid-->
		<NeoGridFiscalList>
			<xsl:for-each select="ROOT/NFe[cnpjEmit/CNPJ != '' or cpfEmit/CPF !='']">
				<NeoGridFiscalDoc>
					<Messages>
						<Message docType="NFe" flowType="send">
							<NFe xmlns="http://www.portalfiscal.inf.br/nfe">
								<infNFe>
									<xsl:attribute name="versao">
										<xsl:value-of select="versao"/>
									</xsl:attribute>
									<xsl:attribute name="Id">
										<xsl:value-of select="normalize-space(Id)"/>
									</xsl:attribute>
									<ide>
										<cUF>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cUF"/>
										</cUF>

										<natOp>

										</natOp>
										<mod>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/mod"/>
										</mod>
										<serie>
											<xsl:value-of select="number(ide/serie)"/>
										</serie>
										<nNF>
											<xsl:value-of select="number(ide/nNF)"/>
										</nNF>
										<dhEmi>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/dhEmi"/>
										</dhEmi>
										<xsl:if test="ide/dhSaiEnt!=''">
											<dhSaiEnt>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/dhSaiEnt"/>
											</dhSaiEnt>
										</xsl:if>
										<tpNF>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpNF"/>
										</tpNF>
										<idDest>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/idDest"/>
										</idDest>
										<cMunFG>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cMunFG"/>
										</cMunFG>
										<tpImp>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/tpImp!=''">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpImp"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>1</xsl:otherwise>
											</xsl:choose>
										</tpImp>
										<tpEmis>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/tpEmis!=''">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpEmis"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>1</xsl:otherwise>
											</xsl:choose>
										</tpEmis>
										<cDV>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/cDV"/>
										</cDV>
										<tpAmb>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/tpAmb!=''">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/tpAmb"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>2</xsl:otherwise>
											</xsl:choose>
										</tpAmb>
										<finNFe>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/finNFe"/>
										</finNFe>
										<indFinal>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/indFinal"/>
										</indFinal>
										<indPres>
											<xsl:value-of select="ide/indPres"/>
										</indPres>
										<xsl:if test="ide/indIntermed!=''">
											<indIntermed>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/indIntermed"/>
											</indIntermed>
										</xsl:if>
										<procEmi>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/procEmi!=''">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/procEmi"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>0</xsl:otherwise>
											</xsl:choose>
										</procEmi>
										<verProc>
											<xsl:choose>
												<xsl:when test="ide/verProc!='' and number(ide/verProc)!='0'">
													<xsl:value-of select="ide/verProc"/>
												</xsl:when>
												<xsl:otherwise>5.0</xsl:otherwise>
											</xsl:choose>
										</verProc>
										<xsl:if test="number(ide/tpEmis) !='1'">
											<dhCont>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/dhCont"/>
											</dhCont>
											<xJust>
												<xsl:value-of select="ide/xJust"/>
											</xJust>
										</xsl:if>
										<!--Inicio Notas Referenciadas-->
										<xsl:for-each select="ide/refNFe[refNFe!='' and number(refNFe)!='0']">
											<NFref>
												<refNFe>
													<xsl:value-of select="refNFe"/>
												</refNFe>
											</NFref>
										</xsl:for-each>
										<!--Inicio Notas Referenciadas Zerada-->
										<xsl:for-each select="ide/refNFe[refNFeSig!='']">
											<NFref>
												<refNFeSig>
													<xsl:value-of select="refNFeSig"/>
												</refNFeSig>
											</NFref>
										</xsl:for-each>
										<xsl:for-each select="ide/refNF[cUF_refNF!='' and number(cUF_refNF)!='0' and AAMM_refNF!='' and number(AAMM_refNF)!='0']">
											<NFref>
												<refNF>
													<cUF>
														<xsl:value-of select="cUF_refNF"/>
													</cUF>
													<AAMM>
														<xsl:value-of select="AAMM_refNF"/>
													</AAMM>
													<CNPJ>
														<xsl:value-of select="CNPJ_refNF"/>
													</CNPJ>
													<mod>
														<xsl:value-of select="mod_refNF"/>
													</mod>
													<serie>
														<xsl:value-of select="number(serie_refNF)"/>
													</serie>
													<nNF>
														<xsl:value-of select="number(nNF_refNF)"/>
													</nNF>
												</refNF>
											</NFref>
										</xsl:for-each>
										<xsl:for-each select="ide/refNFP[cUF_refNFP!='' and number(cUF_refNFP)!='0' and AAMM_refNFP!='' and number(AAMM_refNFP)!='0']">
											<NFref>
												<refNFP>
													<cUF>
														<xsl:value-of select="cUF_refNFP"/>
													</cUF>
													<AAMM>
														<xsl:value-of select="AAMM_refNFP"/>
													</AAMM>
													<xsl:choose>
														<xsl:when test="CNPJ_refNFP!='' and number(CNPJ_refNFP)!='0'">
															<CNPJ>
																<xsl:value-of select="CNPJ_refNFP"/>
															</CNPJ>
														</xsl:when>
														<xsl:otherwise>
															<CPF>
																<xsl:value-of select="CPF_refNFP"/>
															</CPF>
														</xsl:otherwise>
													</xsl:choose>
													<IE>
														<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(IE_refNFP,'/',''),'-',''),'.','')"/>
													</IE>
													<mod>
														<xsl:value-of select="mod_refNFP"/>
													</mod>
													<serie>
														<xsl:value-of select="number(serie_refNFP)"/>
													</serie>
													<nNF>
														<xsl:value-of select="number(nNF_refNFP)"/>
													</nNF>
												</refNFP>
											</NFref>
										</xsl:for-each>
										<xsl:for-each select="ide/refCTe[refCTe!='' and number(refCTe)!='0']">
											<NFref>
												<refCTe>
													<xsl:value-of select="refCTe"/>
												</refCTe>
											</NFref>
										</xsl:for-each>
										<xsl:for-each select="ide/refECF[nECF_refECF!='' and number(nECF_refECF)!='0' and nCOO_refECF!='' and number(nCOO_refECF)!='0']">
											<NFref>
												<refECF>
													<mod>
														<xsl:value-of select="mod_refECF"/>
													</mod>
													<nECF>
														<xsl:value-of select="nECF_refECF"/>
													</nECF>
													<nCOO>
														<xsl:value-of select="nCOO_refECF"/>
													</nCOO>
												</refECF>
											</NFref>
										</xsl:for-each>
										<!--Fim Notas Referenciadas-->
									</ide>
									<emit>
										<xsl:choose>
											<xsl:when test="cnpjEmit/CNPJ!='' and number(cnpjEmit/CNPJ)!='0'">
												<CNPJ>
													<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(cnpjEmit/CNPJ,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
												</CNPJ>
											</xsl:when>
											<xsl:otherwise>
												<CPF>
													<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(cpfEmit/CPF,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>

											</xsl:otherwise>

										<xNome>

										<xsl:if test="Emit/xFant!=''">
											<xFant>

											</xFant>
										</xsl:if>
										<enderEmit>
											<xLgr>
												<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/xLgr"/>
											</xLgr>

												<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/nro"/>
											</nro>
											<xsl:if test="enderEmit/xCpl!=''">

													<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/xCpl"/>
												</xCpl>
											</xsl:if>
											<xBairro>
												<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/xBairro"/>
											</xBairro>
											<cMun>
												<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/cMun"/>
											</cMun>
											<xMun>
												<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/xMun"/>
											</xMun>
											<UF>
												<xsl:variable name="minusculas">abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz</xsl:variable>
												<xsl:variable name="maiusculas">ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ</xsl:variable>
												<xsl:value-of select="translate(enderEmit/UF,$minusculas,$maiusculas)"/>
											</UF>
											<CEP>
												<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(enderEmit/CEP,'/',''),'.',''),'-','')"/>
											</CEP>

													<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/cPais"/>
												</cPais>
											</xsl:if>
											<xsl:if test="enderEmit/xPais!='' and number(enderEmit/xPais)!='0'">
												<xPais>
													<xsl:value-of select="enderEmit/xPais"/>
												</xPais>
											</xsl:if>

													<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(translate(enderEmit/fone,'(',''),')',''),'.',''),',',''),'/',''),' ',''),'-','')"/>
												</fone>
											</xsl:if>
										</enderEmit>
										<IE>
											<xsl:value-of select="translate(translate(translate(Emit/IE,'/',''),'-',''),'.','')"/>
										</IE>
										<xsl:if test="Emit/IEST!='' and number(Emit/IEST)!='0'">
